description.zh: 按文件名找压缩包里的文件：zip、7z、rar、tar.gz 等。直接在搜索框里输入名字就能搜到，或输入 zip 加空格只看压缩包里的。后台只读文件列表，不解压
description.en: Finds files by name inside archives: zip, 7z, rar, tar.gz and more. Type the name in the search box, or zip and a space for archives only. Only the lists of files are read, in the background; nothing is unpacked

files:read: Win顺 索引里的压缩包 / The archives in Win顺's index

description.zh: 按文件名找压缩包里的文件

hint.zh: 压缩包里的文件名，例如：报价单
hint.en: a file name inside an archive, e.g. invoice

title.zh: 打开压缩包所在文件夹
title.en: Show the archive in its folder

ai.description: Find files by name inside the archives on this PC (zip, 7z, rar, tar and its compressed kinds, cab, iso): give part of the file name; several words must all be in the member's path. Each item's title is the member's name, its subtitle the archive's full path and the folder inside it. search_files does not look inside archives; use this when a file may be packed in one.

hint.zh: 用空格隔开，例如 jar apk epub。已包含 zip、7z、rar、tar、tar.gz、tgz、tar.xz、txz、cab、iso
hint.en: Separated by spaces, e.g. jar apk epub. Already in: zip, 7z, rar, tar, tar.gz, tgz, tar.xz, txz, cab, iso

hint.zh: 用分号隔开，例如 %USERPROFILE%\Downloads;D:\备份。留空是本机全部磁盘
hint.en: Separated by semicolons, e.g. %USERPROFILE%\Downloads;D:\Backup. Empty: all local drives

title.zh: 也收录系统和程序文件夹里的压缩包
title.en: Also archives in system and program folders
